metaTitle: Custom Unisex Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom unisex badge ID holders for your team. Perfect Imprints offers versatile, bulk designs for any workplace.
introHtml: Unisex badge ID holders work for any employee, regardless of gender, making them a smart choice for companies that need one style for the whole team. These holders come in neutral colors like black, gray, or navy and fit standard horizontal or vertical ID cards. Whether you need retractable reels, lanyard attachments, or clip-on options, unisex designs simplify ordering and ensure consistency across your workforce. Durable materials like clear vinyl or soft PVC keep badges visible and protected.
heroAltText: Custom unisex badge ID holders with retractable reels and clear vinyl pouches for employee identification
